scope: Linear and circular four-product data with D, Df, Dgen, Dfgen, DLLS and DfLLS tables. Includes variable time and channel solutions, G/D/P order, flags, missing antennas, subselected channels, and unequal scalar and spectral weights.
controls: Nonfinite full leakage matrix flags all products and substitutes identity for the bad antenna.
Missing cross-hand products return an application error.
One-receptor D table returns a catchable shape error.
